parsed.rationale: One copy of `DebugMetricsProvider.setUpDisplayLink` lives in the canonical library location (`Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift`, package `DebugPanel`), while the duplicate resides in `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift` — a path that contains the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp` segment, which is a sample-app tree. Sample-app targets routinely inline or re-implement debug utilities to remain self-contained and avoid adding a hard dependency on a library package. Although neither record carries `is_sample_app=true` in its context flags, the file path `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp` is unambiguous evidence of a sample-app context. Consolidating the two would couple the sample app to the `DebugPanel` package, which is likely undesirable. No refactor is warranted.
